title: Pin a cross-language (JS/Rust) registration identity digest for test-run requests that name input "commit"
outcome: A fixture pins the launcher's JS requestIdentity (scripts/test-run-registration.mjs) and the host's test_run_registration_identity (src/test_run_registration.rs) to the same digest for a request with input "commit", and ideally also for input null. The pinned no-input digest that exists today stays. Today only a Rust test checks that a request with input hashes differently from the no-input digest. If the two implementations drift, every committed-input run fails at registration acknowledgement, and only at runtime. Provenance: w-decd61d62831 review round 6 Low (Claude delegation 63db1c89).
acceptance: Pin a cross-language (JS/Rust) registration identity digest for test-run requests that name input "commit" is done
